title_zh: 五名工人与四项工作的成本分配
description_en: Assign four civilian workshop tasks T0,T1,T2,T3 to five workers W0,W1,W2,W3,W4. Each task must be assigned to exactly one worker. Each worker can perform at most one task; one worker may remain idle. The cost matrix, with rows W0 to W4 and columns T0 to T3, is [[90,80,75,70],[35,85,55,65],[125,95,90,95],[45,110,95,115],[50,100,90,100]]. Minimize total assignment cost.
description_zh: 五名工人承接四项工作，每项工作恰好一人，每人至多一项，允许有人闲置。根据5行4列的成本表，求总成本最小的分配。
modeling_notes_en: This English statement is a demo paraphrase of the official tutorial, not a quoted benchmark record. Assignments are binary. Keep task identifiers T0,T1,T2,T3 and worker order. Quantity unit: assignments. Objective unit: cost_units.
